summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.01/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.01 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 5, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since September 11. AAA figures put the statewide average 28¢ lower than a week ago, 5¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.24 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.75) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.32).
